Hence equation of required tangent is

questions.q: A glass rod of radius ' $r$ ' ' is inserted symmetrically into a vertical capillary tube of radius ' $\mathrm{r}_2$ ' $\left(\mathrm{r}_1 \lt  \mathrm{r}_2\right)$ such that their lower ends are at same level. questions.solution:
Vertical component of total force of surface tension

\mathrm{F}=\left(\mathrm{r}_2+\mathrm{r}_1\right) 2 \pi \mathrm{T} \cos \theta

Weight of the liquid in the capillary

\mathrm{W}=\pi\left(\mathrm{r}_2^2-\mathrm{r}_1^2\right) \mathrm{h} \rho \mathrm{g}

This is balanced by the vertical component of the face due to the surface tension

\therefore \pi\left(\mathrm{r}_2^2-\mathrm{r}_1^2\right) \mathrm{h} \rho \mathrm{g}=\left(\mathrm{r}_2+\mathrm{r}_1\right) \times 2 \pi \mathrm{T} \cos \theta

Simplifying and solving for $\mathrm{h}$ we get,

\mathrm{h}=\frac{2 \mathrm{~T} \cos \theta}{\left(\mathrm{r}_2-\mathrm{r}_1\right) \rho g}=\frac{2 \mathrm{~T}}{\left(\mathrm{r}_2-\mathrm{r}_1\right) \rho g}

(For pure water, $\theta=0^{\circ}, \cos \theta=1$ )

questions.solution: Distance of $\mathrm{n}^{\text {th }}$ dark band from the central bright band $=\left(\mathrm{n}-\frac{1}{2}\right) \beta$

questions.q: In biprism experiment, $6^{\text {th }}$ bright band with wavelength ' $\lambda_1$ ' coincides with $7^{\text {th }}$ dark band with wavelength ' $\lambda_2$ ' then the ratio $\lambda_1: \lambda_2$ is (other setting remains the same)
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \text { Distance of } 6^{\text {th }} \text { bright band }=\frac{6 \lambda_1 D}{d} \\ & \text { Distance of } 7^{\text {th }} \text { dark band }=\frac{6.5 \lambda_2 D}{d} \\ & \therefore \frac{6 \lambda_1 D}{d}=\frac{6.5 \lambda_2 D}{d} \\ & \therefore \frac{\lambda_1}{\lambda_2}=\frac{6.5}{6}=\frac{13}{12}\end{aligned}$
